label: Finding-38
title: disclosure-22oct: The BBC capture does not say the flaws were disclosed on 22 October
description: The claim's 'by' is 'BBC framing (UK morning coverage)', but the captured BBC live page (080559Z, and the 07:55Z raw copy) gives no disclosure date; it says details 'leaked online this week' and the patch 'has been rushed out'. Labelling a BBC statement 'contradicted' when the BBC did not make it misattributes. The '22 October' dates in the vault come from the original schedule (Foundation: 'from October 22nd, 14:00 UTC'), Wiz's thread ('Apply the Oct 22 security release') and ACSC's local time ('22 October 2026 at 0100 AEDT').
